#############################################Fig.3_iCAMP plot#########################################


library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(patchwork)


# 1. AMF

# Phylogenetic signal selection
rm(list=ls())
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu/iCAMP2/output0/")
phy_sig <- read.csv("Test.PhyloSignalSummary.csv")
phy_sig2 <- na.omit(melt(phy_sig[(phy_sig$index=="RAsig.adj" | phy_sig$index=="MeanR"),c(2:3,6:11)], id=c("n.min","index")))

p1_amf <- ggplot(data=phy_sig2, aes(x=n.min, y=value, color=factor(variable))) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype=factor(index))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "AM fungi-Phylogenetic signal", x="N.min", y= "Value") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(12,96,by=12), limits = c(12,96)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red","purple","blue","brown","darkgreen","darkblue"),
                     label= c("pH.pearson"="pH",
                              "salt_content.pearson"="Salt content",
                              "avail_p.pearson"="Available phosphorus",
                              "tn.pearson"="Total nitrogen",
                              "tc.perason"="Total carbon",
                              "tp.pearson"="Total phosphorus")) +
  annotate("text", x=20, y=0.90, label="ds = 0.2", color="red", size=5) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(color=guide_legend(title="Environment factor"),
         linetype=guide_legend(title="Type")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,face = "bold",hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12,face = "bold"))
print(p1_amf)

# Calculation community assembly process
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("p1_amf")))
setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/AMF/otu/iCAMP2/output/")

result_icamp <- read.csv("AMF.ProcessImportance_EachGroup.csv")
result_icamp2 <- result_icamp[result_icamp$Group %in% c("CK","CL","JP","YM","MH"), ]

result_all2 <- result_icamp2[(result_icamp2$ds==0.2 & result_icamp2$n.min==72),c(5:10)]
result_all2 <- melt(result_all2,id="Group")

# prop.test
sig_test <- result_all2[result_all2$value >0.01,]

sig_test$group2 <- "test"
sig_test[sig_test$Group == "CK" |sig_test$Group == "JP" | sig_test$Group == "CL" ,]$group2 <- "Wildland"
sig_test[sig_test$Group == "YM" | sig_test$Group == "MH" ,]$group2 <- "Farmland"

for (i in c("HoS", "DL", "DR")){
  
  farmland_successes <- c(sig_test[sig_test$variable == i & sig_test$group2 == "Farmland", "value"]*100)
  farmland_total <- c(100, 100)
  
  # 荒地组的成功次数和总样本数
  wildland_successes <- c(sig_test[sig_test$variable == i & sig_test$group2 == "Wildland", "value"]*100)
  wildland_total <- c(100, 100, 100)
  
  # 使用 prop.test 进行两组比例检验
  result <- prop.test(c(sum(farmland_successes), sum(wildland_successes)), c(sum(farmland_total), sum(wildland_total)))
  print(i)
  print(result)
}


result_all2$group2 <- "test"
result_all2[result_all2$Group == "CK" |result_all2$Group == "JP" | result_all2$Group == "CL" ,]$group2 <- "Wildland"
result_all2[result_all2$Group == "YM" | result_all2$Group == "MH" ,]$group2 <- "Farmland"
result_all3 <- aggregate(. ~ group2 + variable,result_all2[,2:4], FUN="mean")

# plot
p2_amf <- ggplot(data=result_all3,aes(x = factor(group2, levels = c("Wildland","Farmland")), y = as.numeric(value),fill = factor(variable))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data=result_all3[result_all3$value >0.01,],aes(label=paste0(round(value*100),"%"), color=factor(variable)),
            position = position_stack(vjust =0.5),size=3,fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=c("Wildland"), y=c(0.55), label=c("***"), size=5, color="white", fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=c("Wildland"), y=c(0.12), label=c("*"), size=5, color="white", fontface="bold") +
  annotate("text", x=c("Farmland"), y=c(0.26), label=c("***"), size=5, color="black", fontface="bold") +
  labs(title = "AM fungi", x="Habitat", y= "Community assembly process (%)") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("white","white","black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3b3b3b","#5c7cbc","#d580ec","#47ced1","#fde725"),
                    label= c("HeS"="Heterogeneous selection",
                             "HoS"="Homogeneous selection",
                             "DL"="Dispersal limitation",
                             "HD"="Homogeneous dispsersal",
                             "DR"="Drift")) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Process"),
         color="none") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=20,face = "bold",hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size=12,color ="black",face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=15,face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12,face = "bold"))

print(p2_amf)

for (i in c("DL")){
  sig_test <- sig_test[sig_test$Group != "MH",]
